name: docs-cookbook
body:
Cookbook (docs/cookbook.md): a repo `docs/cookbook.md` is a task-recipe reference for template authors, each recipe a small copyable layout or YAML snippet. It includes at least: a reusable footer rendered via the `.slide` context (`{{ .slide.number }} / {{ .slide.total }}`), a nested child/children composition (a `section` call passing `child` arguments and `children` forwardings), a wrapper layout that forwards its own authored children with `children`, and theme `media:`/`theme:<name>/` references. README.md links to it.

AC: docs/cookbook.md exists and is linked from README.md; it contains at least the footer-via-`.slide`, nested child/children, wrapper-layout, and theme `media:`/`theme:<name>/` recipes, each a copyable snippet consistent with section-helper, child-constructor, children-forwarding and theme-media-references.
